name: The Last Bell
detailed_description:
The Last Bell
Death is Not the End.

Trapped in a cursed, abandoned school where discipline takes a horrifying turn, four Students must outsmart a merciless Hunter in a heart-pounding game of survival. Choose your side and immerse yourself in this chilling asymmetrical multiplayer horror experience.

Students play in third-person for heightened situational awareness, while the Hunter adopts a first-person view, relentlessly tracking their prey.

Each game is a race against time, as the Students strive to unlock the escape door while the Hunter uses their arsenal of abilities to stop them. No two matches are ever the same in this procedurally generated environment of terror and strategy.

Key Features

• Outsmart or Be Caught – Students must work together—or act selfishly—to survive. Will you risk saving your teammates or focus solely on your own escape? The choice is yours, but the Hunter is always watching.

• A School of Horrors – Explore a procedurally generated map filled with eerie classrooms, haunting corridors, and discipline chairs that may seal your fate. Each playthrough feels fresh, unpredictable, and terrifying.

• The Hunter's Pursuit – Step into the shoes of a terrifying Hunter. Wield unique powers like tracking blood trails and exploiting sound cues. Discipline your victims with precision and unleash your finishing moves to assert dominance.

• Progress and Customize – Both Hunters and Students have deep progression systems. Unlock perks, upgrades, and cosmetic options to suit your playstyle and stand out in the nightmare.

• Atmosphere of Fear – Immerse yourself in a world of tension with dynamic lighting, haunting music, and unsettling sound effects that make each moment pulse with dread.

---

Warning: Photosensitivity/Epilepsy Seizures – A very small percentage of individuals may experience seizures or other discomfort when exposed to certain visual patterns or flashing lights. Please play responsibly and consult a physician if you have any concerns.

Do you have what it takes to escape, or will you be claimed by the curse? The bell tolls for you.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit Operating System
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4170 or AMD FX-8120
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX11 Compatible GeForce GTX 460 1GB or AMD HD 6850 1GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DX11 compatible
  • Additional Notes: With these requirements, it is recommended that the game is played on Low quality settings.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit Operating System
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4170 or AMD FX-8300 or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX11 Compatible GeForce 760 or AMD HD 8800 or higher with 4GB of RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DX11 compatible
